# How your pages show up

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### noindex
- What: Tell search engines not to list private pages.
- Applies when: a web app with private pages is going live.
- Stage: go-live
- Kind: checkable

### Social preview
- What: The title, text and image that appear when someone shares a link to your app.
- Applies when: public web pages are going live.
- Stage: go-live
- Kind: checkable
